% A \thechapter set by the class, test-thechap-class.cls, which loads book
% and numbers chapters in Roman numerals, and not by the preamble: chapter
% and section numbers, the table of contents, references with hyperref,
% and unnumbered front-matter and back-matter chapters.
\documentclass{test-thechap-class}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\begin{document}
\frontmatter
\chapter{Preface}\label{preface}
Front text.
\tableofcontents
\mainmatter
\chapter{Start}\label{start}
\section{Basics}\label{basics}
Ref: \ref{start}; \ref{basics}; \ref{second}.
\chapter{Second}\label{second}
Here \ref{second}.
\backmatter
\chapter{Afterword}\label{afterword}
Back text.
\end{document}
